Job Description
 About the Role
 We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team!
We strongly believe that “Ideas power everything!”, so here you’ll find the context where all your initiatives not only will be heard, but really appreciated!
We run a large-scale, enterprise-grade web platform on Microsoft Azure, built on a microservice architecture and delivered globally via CDN. As a DevOps engineer, you'll own the infrastructure lifecycle end-to-end — from provisioning developer environments through CI/CD pipelines to production operations. You'll be embedded in a cross-functional, agile team working alongside backend engineers, frontend engineers, and product owners.
This is an office-hours role — no on-call or out-of-hours duty.
 Responsibilities
 Provision and maintain cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code
 Build and operate multi-stage CI/CD pipelines with release promotion across environments
 Manage Kubernetes clusters, networking, secrets, and monitoring
 Support production releases and triage escalated incidents during business hours
 Automate environment provisioning, deployment workflows, and dependency updates
 Document infrastructure decisions and components for cross-team consumption
 Required Technical Skills And Experience
 Azure Cloud - AKS, Service Bus, Event Hub, Functions, Key Vault, SQL / Elastic Pool, Blob Storage, Container Registry, Application Gateway, VNet / Private Endpoints, Monitor & Application Insights
 Kubernetes - cluster operations, namespace management, network policies, autoscaling, workload identity
 Terraform - production-grade IaC with the Azure provider, resource dependency management, plan/apply lifecycle
 Helm - chart management, versioning, deploying services into Kubernetes
 CI/CD Pipelines - multi-stage YAML pipelines (Azure DevOps or similar), release candidate promotion, feature toggles, regression test integration
 Monitoring & Alerting - metric and log-based alerts, severity-based escalation, dashboards across compute, messaging, database, and networking layers
 Scripting - PowerShell Core or equivalent for provisioning and deployment automation
 Incident triage - ability to diagnose issues across Kubernetes pods, application gateways, message queues, serverless functions, and databases
 Nice To Have
 CDN configuration and cache invalidation strategies (e.g. Akamai)
 Multi-layer caching awareness (application cache, CDN, origin)
 Advanced Kubernetes operations (jobs, node pool strategies, eviction handling)
 Automated dependency management (Renovate or similar)
 Per-developer environment provisioning pipelines
 Basic .NET / C# literacy for cross-team incident triage
 Azure cost monitoring and budget alerting
 Bastion, backup, and compliance tooling
 Other Requirements
 Strong sense of team collaboration - proactive communication with team and client stakeholders, peer reviews for infrastructure changes
 Documentation discipline
 Experience working in agile, multi-vendor environments
 Must be fluent in English, written and verbal communications
